CustomField.formula:
IF(
cmbls__Total_Credits_Settled__c=0,"No Balance",
IF( cmbls__Total_Outstanding_Amount__c / cmbls__Total_Credits_Settled__c > 1, IMAGE("/img/samples/color_red.gif", "None", 0, 0) + IMAGE("/img/samples/color_red.gif", "red", 15, 100), IMAGE("/img/samples/color_red.gif", "None", 0, 0) + IMAGE("/img/samples/color_green.gif", "green", 15, IF((100 - (cmbls__Total_Outstanding_Amount__c / cmbls__Total_Credits_Settled__c) * 100) <=100, (100 - (cmbls__Total_Outstanding_Amount__c / cmbls__Total_Credits_Settled__c) * 100), 100)) & IMAGE("/img/samples/color_red.gif", "None", 0, 0) + IMAGE("/img/samples/color_yellow.gif", "yellow", 15, 100 - (100 - (cmbls__Total_Outstanding_Amount__c / cmbls__Total_Credits_Settled__c) * 100))
)
& " " & TEXT( ROUND( ((100 - (cmbls__Total_Outstanding_Amount__c / cmbls__Total_Credits_Settled__c) * 100)), 0 ) )
& "%" )
CustomField.label: Payoff %
